ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled egg, soft fluffy curds with some darker golden edges, moist-looking, sits in the upper right of the plate in a mound roughly 12 cm across and about 2 cm high, covering about 25% of the plate | 130
ITEM 2 | Shredded potato, pale cream strands with browned crispy bits and reddish-brown edges, dry-looking, loosely packed patty-like pile in the left center about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm high, covering about 15% of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens, dark purple-red and bright green leaves, some glossy and some matte, slightly wilted, scattered across the lower right in a spread about 10 cm across and 1 cm high, covering about 15% of the plate | 35
ITEM 4 | Whole strawberry halves, bright red with visible seeds and slightly glossy surface, one whole berry about 3 cm and one partial piece about 2 cm, resting on the greens | 15
